title: Exclude
scene: At a school lunch table three students sit close together, turned inward to talk. A fourth student stands a short distance away holding a lunch tray, looking uncertain and left out. An empty chair near the group is blocked by a backpack. No one laughs or points at the standing student. Show the ordinary small act of leaving someone out with calm respectful expressions and natural arms.
alt: Three students talk in a close group at lunch while another stands apart holding a tray; a backpack blocks the nearby empty chair.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square glossary illustration for a middle-school Crew SEL pack. Style: warm simple flat illustration with muted earth colors, clean uncluttered shapes, softly textured paper and respectful expressions. Fictional diverse students ages 12 to 14. No words, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos or watermarks. Every person must have exactly two naturally attached arms and coherent hair.
